title: Excalibur | L_Ender 's Cataclysm Support
body:
![TITLE](https://i.imgur.com/1uaWD3z.png)

![Showcase1](https://i.imgur.com/zbCowDY.png)

![Showcase2](https://i.imgur.com/W6VTNCU.png)

This unofficial compatibility pack ensures that the textures in the [L\_Ender 's Cataclysm](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lendercataclysm) Mod seamlessly integrate with the amazing [Excalibur](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur) resource pack.

**Features:**

*   Retextured all entities, items, blocks and spawn eggs.
*   3D weapons are displayed as 2D sprites in the inventory.
*   Includes random entity variants.
*   Changes shulker colors slightly to match the logic of the pack.

For the best experience, use this pack alongside Excalibur.

**Credits:**

*   Maffhew – Creator of _Excalibur_
*   mcl\_ender – Creator of _L\_Ender 's Cataclysm_
*   JackieVile – Contributed most block textures and some entity textures
*   LowPassFilter – Contributed the Deeplings textures

If this pack pleases thine eye, grant it a heart or spread word of it afar! 🏰

[Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur-l-ender-s-cataclysm)
